claims.statement: The HR Agent system is a full-stack application with a Vue 3 TypeScript frontend communicating with a Spring Boot 3 backend via REST API / SSE, backed by MySQL, Redis, and Flowable.
The AI Agent engine uses a ReAct loop with ModelThinkNode and ToolExecuteNode, supporting up to MAX_TOOL_CALLS (8) iterations per turn, with dynamic tool filtering based on user intent.
Flowable BPMN 2.0 engine provides workflow automation for HR processes (onboarding, offboarding, transfer, probation completion), with ACT_* tables auto-created on first boot.
Security includes AES-256-CBC encryption for sensitive fields, Redis SETNX deduplication with 3s TTL, rate limiting at 2 requests per 5 seconds, and Redisson distributed locking.
Frontend is built with Vue 3 and Vite, serving static assets, with API proxy configured to forward /api requests to the backend.
